## What is calculated

Federal income tax and employee FICA; progressive state income tax after a $8,000 deduction; progressive NYC resident income tax; employer FICA, FUTA, and representative new-employer SUTA.

The model assumes a single filer using the standard deduction, with no dependents,
credits, itemized deductions, benefits, or workers' compensation. See the
[shared US methodology](README.md) for the exact federal parameters and executable
calculation used with this location configuration.
